account.instructions: Sign in through a remote browser. If LUX MED asks for a code, enter it there, then return and check the connection.
account.title: LUX MED account
editor.choose_service: Select a service from the list.
editor.facilities_hint: Choose clinics. With none selected, the search includes all clinics.
editor.hours_hint: Choose “Every day” or individual days. With nothing selected, the search includes all times.
error.access_denied: This account does not have access to the app.
error.browser_busy: The browser is busy. Close the sign-in window or try again in a moment.
error.connect_first: Sign in to LuxMed in Settings, then try again.
error.invalid_fields: Check the fields you filled in.
error.open_from_bot: Use /app in your private chat with the bot to open the app.
error.reopen: Reopen the app from your private chat with the bot.
error.stale: The data has changed. Reopen this screen.
error.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
history.empty_hint: Your search results will appear here.
history.expired: This appointment is no longer available
home.intro: Set up a search and get a Telegram message when a slot opens.
home.title: Find a LUX MED appointment
viewer.access_denied: This account does not have access to the app.
viewer.connected: Swipe or use the arrows to scroll the page.
viewer.disconnected: The sign-in window is closed. Return to the bot.
viewer.failed: Connection failed. Ask the bot for a new link.
viewer.paste_manually: Use your device’s Paste command in the keyboard field.
viewer.paste_empty: There’s no text on the clipboard.
viewer.paste_too_long: The clipboard text is too long.
viewer.keyboard_hint: Tap a field in LuxMed, then type here.
viewer.missing: Open a new sign-in link from your private chat with the bot.
viewer.remote_notice: Sign-in takes place in a browser on the server. Its profile keeps cookies so searches can continue after you close the window. Sign out in the LUX MED portal to end the session.
viewer.title: Sign in to LuxMed
viewer.zoomed: Drag to pan. Use the arrows to scroll the page.
watches.empty_hint: Choose a service and dates. The bot will message you when it finds an appointment.
